sources.summary: British-Nigerian designer Yinka Ilori selects his favourite pieces from his recently released Dunelm collection in this video filmed by Dezeen. In the video, filmed at the launch event in London, Ilori tells Dezeen editor Tom Ravenscroft about his favourite pieces in the collection and why he chose them. View this post on Instagram A The post Yinka Ilori's top four pieces from his Dunelm collection appeared first on Dezeen .
